1. Be respectful to others.

2. No spamming, advertising, random pings, or unsolicited DMs. (Don't be annoying)

3. No offensive, hurtful, derogatory, or NSFW behaviour.

4. Try to keep the tone/vibe lighthearted and chilled out.

5. Use English in public channels/chat.

6. Do not try to loophole or get around punishments using alt accounts. (Be honest)

1. No hacking, cheating, or x-raying to get an unfair advantage over others.

2. All forms of stealing, griefing, and raiding are forbidden.

3. Do not use exploits or glitches to gain an unfair advantage over others or hinder others' gameplay..

4. PvP (killing other players) is allowed, just do not do so excessively or in an annoying/hurtful way.

5. Do not use auto clickers, auto reconnect mods, or similar tools to get around the AFK timeout.

6. The Minecraft Usage Guidelines must be complied with at all times.
For more details about the rules and information about moderation visit our website by Clicking Here
